name: Lake Balaton
tagline: Central Europe's largest lake, a shallow, warm inland sea with volcanic hills, vineyards, an abbey peninsula and a lively summer shore.
highlight: Tihany Abbey on its peninsula above the lake at sunset, with lavender fields in July.
shortDescription: A 77-km-long lake with the Tihany Peninsula, Badacsony's basalt hills and wine, Balatonfüred's promenade and the Festetics Palace at Keszthely, popular for swimming, sailing and wine.
metaDescription: A Lake Balaton travel guide: Tihany Abbey, Badacsony wine and hiking, Balatonfüred promenade, Keszthely and the Festetics Palace, swimming and sailing, food, where to stay and a two-day plan.
nearestAirport: Budapest Ferenc Liszt (BUD), about 1.5–2 hours; Hévíz-Balaton (SOB) for some flights
knownFor: Lake swimming, Tihany, Badacsony wine, summer holidays

image.alt: Lake Balaton stretching to the horizon under a soft sky

intro: Lake Balaton is the largest lake in Central Europe, about 77 km long and 14 km across at its widest, but only around 3 metres deep on average, so its water warms quickly in summer. It has been Hungary's favourite holiday destination for over a century, called the 'Hungarian sea', and every summer the shores fill with families, sailors and swimmers.

The two shores are different. The south shore is flat, with sandy beaches and lively resort towns such as Siófok, known for parties. The north shore is hilly and more attractive, with volcanic hills around Badacsony, vineyards, lavender fields, and historic towns. The Tihany Peninsula has a Benedictine abbey from the 11th century and views of the lake, and Balatonfüred, an elegant spa town, has a shady promenade named after the poet Rabindranath Tagore.

At the western end, Keszthely has the grand baroque Festetics Palace, and nearby Hévíz has the largest thermal lake in Europe. The region is also a wine country, producing crisp whites like Olaszrizling and Kéknyelű. Two or three days on the north shore gives the best taste, ideally in June or September.

whyVisit.intro: Balaton is Hungary's summer playground, with a scenic north shore and excellent wines.

attractionsIntro: The north shore has the best sights.

attractions.name: Tihany Abbey and Peninsula

image.file: File:Tihany Abbey Balaton panorama at sunset.jpg
image.alt: Tihany Abbey on the peninsula above Lake Balaton at sunset

attractions.text: A baroque abbey church on a hill, above a village of thatched cottages, with views over the lake and lavender fields in early summer.
attractions.tip: Go in late June for lavender.

attractions.name: Badacsony

image.alt: The flat-topped basalt Badacsony hill rising above Lake Balaton

attractions.text: A basalt hill with terraced vineyards, hiking trails and wine cellars, and beautiful views of the lake.

attractions.name: Balatonfüred and the Tagore Promenade

image.file: File:Hungary, Balatonfüred, Rabindranath promenade in autumn.jpg
image.alt: The tree-lined Tagore Promenade in Balatonfüred in autumn

attractions.text: An elegant spa town with a tree-lined waterfront promenade, a heart hospital and a sailing harbour.

attractions.name: Festetics Palace, Keszthely

image.alt: The baroque Festetics Palace at Keszthely

attractions.text: A grand baroque palace with a library of 86,000 volumes, formal gardens and a museum.

attractions.name: Hévíz thermal lake
attractions.text: Europe's largest biologically active thermal lake, warm enough to swim in year-round.

attractions.name: Siófok
attractions.text: The party resort town on the south shore.
attractions.tip: Go for the beaches and nightlife.

thingsToDoIntro: Balaton is for water, wine and cycling.

thingsToDo.title: Cycle the shore
thingsToDo.text: A 200-km cycle route around the lake.

foodIntro: Balaton's food is lake fish and wine.

gettingThere.intro: Balaton is 90 to 130 km from Budapest.

options.text: About 1.5 to 2 hours to Balatonfüred or Siófok.

gettingAround.intro: Trains, buses and ferries link the shore.

bestTime.headline: June and September
bestTime.summary: Balaton peaks in July and August, though these are the busiest months.

seasons.text: Cold, with the lake sometimes freezing.

bestTime.avoid: Weekends in peak July and August.

itinerary.title: Two days at Lake Balaton
itinerary.intro: The peninsula and the wine hills.

tipsIntro: A few tips help you plan.
tips: Avoid Siófok if you want quiet.

faq.a: The north shore is more scenic.
